_comment: Personas for the persona×city engine (gen-persona.mjs). Targets 'AI course for <persona> in <city>'. Each carries a distinct angle, pains, AI use-cases and what they build, woven with the city's economy.

personas.label: IT professionals
personas.Title: IT Professionals
personas.angle: move from writing code to building with AI before the shift leaves them behind
personas.pains: AI is reshaping every IT role, and experience alone no longer guarantees relevance
personas.usecases: automate delivery work, build AI features and agents, and add AI to the products they already ship
personas.build: an AI feature or agent wired into a real system, plus automations that cut delivery grunt-work

personas.label: finance professionals
personas.Title: Finance Professionals
personas.angle: use AI on the reporting, analysis and reconciliation work that fills their day
personas.pains: month-close, reconciliation and reporting still eat hours that AI can now take back
personas.usecases: automate reconciliations, analyse financial data with AI, and draft reports and commentary faster
personas.build: an AI-assisted financial analysis and a reporting automation on a real finance workflow
personas.sector: banking, finance and corporate finance teams

personas.label: HR professionals
personas.Title: HR Professionals
personas.angle: put AI to work across hiring, onboarding and people operations
personas.pains: screening, coordination and repetitive people-ops work scale badly by hand
personas.usecases: screen and summarise applications, draft job posts and policies, and automate onboarding and HR queries
personas.build: an AI screening-and-drafting workflow and an HR-query assistant on a real people-ops process

personas.label: sales professionals
personas.Title: Sales Professionals
personas.angle: use AI to research prospects, personalise outreach and close faster
personas.pains: research, follow-ups and personalised outreach take time better spent selling
personas.usecases: research accounts with AI, personalise outreach at scale, and automate follow-ups and CRM updates
personas.build: an AI prospect-research and outreach workflow tied to a real sales process

personas.label: marketing professionals
personas.Title: Marketing Professionals
personas.angle: use AI across content, creative and campaign performance
personas.pains: content volume, creative variants and reporting outpace a small team
personas.usecases: generate on-brand content and creative variants, and tie campaigns to funnel and performance with AI
personas.build: an AI content-and-creative system and a performance view for a real brand

personas.label: healthcare professionals
personas.Title: Healthcare Professionals
personas.angle: use AI on documentation, patient communication and the admin that surrounds care
personas.pains: documentation and coordination take time away from patients
personas.usecases: summarise and draft clinical and admin documents, answer routine queries, and automate coordination
personas.build: a documentation-and-query AI tool on a real healthcare-admin workflow

personas.label: business owners
personas.Title: Business Owners
personas.angle: use AI to run leaner — sales, operations and customer service with a small team
personas.pains: a small team means every repetitive task is a real cost
personas.usecases: automate customer replies, generate sales and marketing content, and streamline operations with AI
personas.build: AI automations for a real business — customer service, content and an operations workflow

personas.label: freshers
personas.Title: Freshers & Students
personas.angle: graduate with AI skills and a real portfolio, not just a certificate
personas.pains: degrees alone no longer stand out; employers want proof you can build
personas.usecases: learn to build real AI projects, and use AI to accelerate learning and job-hunting
personas.build: two to three deployed AI projects that make a fresher's portfolio stand out
personas.sector: the graduate and early-career job market
